target_text:
// save_k marks K exactly once per job with KV work, and K alone does not
    // complete a token. So a second mark completes it only for those jobs.
body:
**[comments] Rule 4, comment lines that map to no code line: shorten**

Four lines sit above two REQUIREs. "(mark_k_complete returns true only when the count was 1)" restates mark_k_complete's own comment in kv_cache.hpp, and "A job without KV work has no mark (count 0)" restates `== (do_kv[job] != 0)`. Line 1 maps to REQUIRE_FALSE(is_kv_complete) (3955) and line 2 to the mark_k_complete probe (3956).

Proposed:
```cpp
    // save_k marks K exactly once per job with KV work, and K alone does not
    // complete a token. So a second mark completes it only for those jobs.
```
